source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 exam booklet screenshot, limits section only

exams.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា

questions.label: a
questions.technique: No indeterminate form: sqrt(x^2-1) is continuous at x=1 (x^2-1=0≥0) and the whole expression is continuous there, so evaluate by direct substitution.

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Divide numerator and denominator by x and apply the standard exponential limit (e^{kx}-1)/x → k separately to numerator (k=4) and denominator (k=1); the ratio is 4/1.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=2. Rationalize the numerator by multiplying by (2+sqrt(x+2)): (4-(x+2))=(2-x), giving -(x-2)/(2+sqrt(x+2)). Factor denominator x^3-8=(x-2)(x^2+2x+4); cancel (x-2), leaving -1/[(2+sqrt(x+2))(x^2+2x+4)].

questions.label: d
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=pi/3. Rewrite sin x - sqrt3 cos x as 2 sin(x-pi/3) (angle-addition identity), giving t/(2 sin t) with t=x-pi/3, then apply the sinc limit t/sin t → 1.
